summary: This is a DeepSeek Harness ACP server plugin that lets ACP-compatible clients connect via stdio or HTTP/SSE to run and manage dsh agent sessions with interactive prompts and tool-driven workflow events.

classificationSuggestion.reason: This plugin’s user-facing purpose is to act as an ACP server frontend for DeepSeek Harness, letting ACP-compatible clients drive dsh coding-agent sessions via stdio or HTTP+SSE. Evidence from the README and package metadata shows it focuses on session orchestration (start, prompt, resume, close), streaming interaction, tool/permission handling, and optional host-plane observability endpoints for jobs/goals/skills/tree rather than standalone coding or UI features.
